items.title: Skydance Plans to Cut $6 Billion in Costs After Swallowing Warner Bros.
items.summary: Skydance has a plan to squeeze billions out of its Warner Bros. megadeal, but the bills arrive long before the savings do. With a heavy debt load and analysts slashing forecasts, one upcoming number could decide whether the bet pays off.

items.title: Skydance Sinks 9% as Warner Bros. Film Slump Overshadows Earnings Beat; Netflix Falls 2%, Disney Dips
items.summary: Skydance crushed profit expectations in its first report as the combined Warner Bros. and Paramount, yet investors still bolted. A looming film problem and a mountain of debt explain why rivals Netflix and Disney barely flinched.
